commits.message: fix(delete-account): page title says what the page is
commits.author: shalombook

commits.message: feat: /delete-account page + privacy policy covers Android (Android plan T2.5) (#171)
commits.author: shalomer

panels.title: feat: /delete-account page
panels.scene: A terrifying giant dark portal labelled 'DELETE ACCOUNT' appears in the town square. Villagers are weeping with joy, throwing flowers into the portal. Knight stands next to it casually leaning on a shovel.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: A void to erase our past! We are free from our sins!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It deletes your row from the database.

panels.title: feat: privacy policy covers Android
panels.scene: A giant green robotic dragon labelled 'Android' hovers above the kingdom. Knight holds up a small parchment scroll to it. Villagers are bowing to the dragon in deep worship.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The Great Green Beast of Android has signed the sacred treaty!

bubbles.speaker: Other Villager
bubbles.text: Our secrets are safe in Plan T2.5!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I copy-pasted three lines of text.

panels.title: fix: page title says what the page is
panels.scene: Villager kneeling on the ground staring at a wooden sign above a shop door that was erased and repainted to say 'Delete Account'. Tears stream down his face.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The magic words have appeared! The browser tab is no longer named Untitled!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I typed eleven letters into the title tag.

panels.title: 2 commits. 1 feature. 1 fix. 1 privacy policy.
panels.scene: Knight sitting exhausted on a wooden bench in the town square. In the background, villagers are carving a golden statue of a giant smartphone holding a sword.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall name our newborn daughter Android-Plan-T2.5!
